cmd: cd /app && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > compile1.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT: $?"; grep -c "Overfull" compile1.log
cd /app && cp input.tex input.tex.bak && echo "backup made"; wc -w input.tex
cd /app && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > compile2.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT: $?"; grep -c "Overfull" compile2.log; echo "---"; grep -A1 "Overfull" compile2.log

cd /app && grep -c "wild excursions" input.tex; grep -c "riotous excursions" input.tex; grep -c "This awareness had" input.tex; grep -c "This responsiveness had" input.tex; grep -c "creative mood" input.tex; grep -c "creative temperament" input.tex; grep -c "a scout, an" input.tex; grep -c "a pathfinder, an" input.tex

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s = open('input.tex').read()
def rep(text, old, new):
    # word-boundary replace, case-sensitive
    pattern = r'(?<![\w-])' + re.escape(old) + r'(?![\w-])'
    new_s, n = re.subn(pattern, new, text)
    print(f"replace {old!r} -> {new!r}: {n} replacement(s)")
    return new_s
s = rep(s, 'riotous', 'wild')
s = rep(s, 'responsiveness', 'awareness')
s = rep(s, 'temperament', 'mood')
s = rep(s, 'pathfinder', 'scout')
open('input.tex','w').write(s)
print("done")
PY
which python python2 perl sed awk 2>&1; echo "---"; perl --version 2>/dev/null | head -2

cd /app && perl -i -pe '
s/(?<![\w-])riotous(?![\w-])/wild/g;
s/(?<![\w-])responsiveness(?![\w-])/awareness/g;
s/(?<![\w-])temperament(?![\w-])/mood/g;
s/(?<![\w-])pathfinder(?![\w-])/scout/g;
' input.tex
echo "=== verify ==="
grep -c "wild excursions" input.tex
grep -c "riotous" input.tex

grep -c "responsiveness" input.tex
grep -c "creative mood" input.tex
grep -c "temperament" input.tex
grep -c "a scout, an" input.tex
